plan.title: Recreate Order: Close with the Cross

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with bids from Vendor A and Vendor B.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration for the buyer tenant.
Open the stage Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Verify the Recreate Order dialog contains the Product Sheet option.
Verify the Recreate Order dialog contains Auction Configurations.
Verify the Recreate Order dialog contains Delivery Date.
Verify the dialog contains the scheduling choice.
Click the dialog's top-right cross to dismiss it; the catalog has no dedicated Recreate Order close step.
Confirm the Recreate Order dialog is closed.
Confirm the buyer remains on the existing event summary rather than entering a newly created order.
